name: B2B sales team
tagline: Leads, qualification, proposals, a clean close.
description: A straightforward business-to-business motion: inbound and outbound leads, a qualifying call, a priced proposal, a round of negotiation, then won or lost. Tracks where the lead came from and nudges the rep when a deal goes quiet.

stages.label: New Lead
stages.desc: Came in from the website, a referral, or outbound

stages.label: Qualified
stages.desc: Discovery call done; real need, budget, timeline

stages.label: Proposal Sent
stages.desc: Priced proposal in the customer's hands

stages.label: Closed Lost
stages.desc: Went elsewhere or went quiet for good

automations.name: Nudge on a quiet deal
automations.title: Check in — no activity for two weeks
automations.why: Two weeks of silence is where deals die.

views.name: Proposals out
views.why: Everything waiting on a customer decision.

name: SaaS / software
description: Software subscriptions sold on trials and demos: scope the seats, quote, clear security review and procurement on larger deals, close an annual contract, and track the renewal date from day one.

stages.label: Trial / Signup
stages.desc: Self-serve trial started or demo requested

stages.label: Demo Done
stages.desc: Walked them through it; scoping seats and plan

stages.label: Lost / Churned Trial
stages.desc: Trial expired or chose another tool

fields.name: contract_value
fields.label: Annual contract value
fields.why: ACV, separate from any one-off services.

fields.name: renewal_date
fields.label: Renewal date
fields.why: The date that matters after the sale.

automations.name: Security review stalling
automations.title: Follow up on security / procurement review
automations.why: Ten quiet days in review means a blocker nobody surfaced.

views.name: In security review
views.why: The stage that quietly eats quarters.

name: Consulting / professional services
description: A consulting firm's path from intro conversation to signed statement of work: discovery, a written scope with a fee, client review, signature. Tracks engagement value, start date, service line, and who referred the client.

stages.label: Discovery
stages.desc: Understanding the problem before we price it

stages.label: Passed
stages.desc: Not now, or not a fit

fields.name: service_line
fields.label: Service line
fields.why: What kind of work it is.

fields.name: referred_by
fields.label: Referred by
fields.why: Referrals are the whole funnel — know who to thank.

automations.name: SOW out for a week
automations.title: Follow up on the SOW
automations.why: A week of silence after a SOW needs a call, not another email.

views.name: SOWs awaiting signature
views.why: Revenue that is one signature away.

name: Marketing / creative agency
description: An agency's new-business flow: a brief or introduction, a chemistry call, a pitch or proposal, then a project or a monthly retainer. Tracks project-vs-retainer, value, the service, and the pitch date; flags big pitches.

stages.label: Brief Received
stages.desc: Inbound brief or a warm intro

stages.label: Chemistry Call
stages.desc: Do we like each other and can we do it

stages.label: Pitch / Proposal
stages.desc: Creative pitch or written proposal in progress

stages.label: Lost
stages.desc: Went to another shop or shelved

fields.name: engagement_type
fields.label: Engagement type
fields.why: One-off vs recurring changes everything about the number.

fields.name: pitch_date
fields.label: Pitch date
fields.why: The day the team has to be ready.

automations.name: Flag big pitches
automations.why: Anything in pitch gets senior eyes.

automations.name: Chase after the pitch
automations.title: Follow up on the pitch decision

name: Recruiting / staffing
description: A recruiting agency working client roles: source, screen, submit a shortlist, run client interviews, extend the offer, make the placement. Each deal is a role; tracks fee, title, salary band, and contract vs permanent.

fields.name: salary_range
fields.label: Salary range
fields.why: Sets candidate expectations and the fee.

automations.name: Shortlist feedback overdue
automations.title: Get client feedback on the shortlist
automations.why: Five days without feedback and your candidates take other offers.

views.name: Offers out
views.why: The roles closest to a fee.

name: Commercial real estate
description: Brokering commercial property: inquiry, showings, letter of intent, lease or purchase negotiation, due diligence, closing. Tracks the property, square footage, lease vs sale, commission, and target close.

stages.label: Inquiry
stages.desc: Interest in a listing or a client we represent

automations.name: Due diligence stalled
automations.title: Check in on due diligence progress
automations.why: Two quiet weeks in diligence usually means a financing or inspection problem.

name: Construction / contracting
description: A contractor's bid pipeline: invitation or request, site visit, estimate, bid submitted, awarded or lost, then contract and mobilization. Tracks bid amount, due date, project type, the GC or owner, and the site.

stages.label: Invitation to Bid
stages.desc: Bid invite or client request received

stages.label: Bid Submitted
stages.desc: Bid is in; waiting on award

stages.label: Lost Bid
stages.desc: Awarded to someone else or cancelled

fields.name: bid_due_date
fields.label: Bid due date
fields.why: The date the estimator lives by.

fields.name: company_role
fields.label: Role on projects
fields.why: Who they are to us on a job.

automations.name: Bid follow-up
automations.title: Follow up on the submitted bid
automations.why: Ten days after submitting, find out where it stands.

automations.name: Awarded jobs are hot
automations.why: Won but not signed is the riskiest week.

name: Wholesale / distribution
description: Distributing product to business customers: new accounts from reps and trade shows, a price list or quote, a first order, then the real business — repeat orders. Tracks annual volume, category, territory, and terms; flags accounts that stop ordering.

stages.label: Prospect
stages.desc: Met at a show or found by a rep

stages.label: Qualified Account
stages.desc: Right size, right products, credit looks fine

fields.name: estimated_annual_volume
fields.label: Estimated annual volume
fields.why: What the account is worth per year.

automations.name: Account gone quiet
automations.title: Reach out — no order in 60 days
automations.why: Sixty days without an order means someone else is supplying them.

name: Equipment dealer
description: Selling and leasing equipment: qualify need and budget, demo, quote with a financing option, negotiate trade-in and terms, close, then deliver and install. Tracks model, new vs used, financing status, and delivery date.

stages.label: Sold — Delivery
stages.desc: Paperwork done; scheduling delivery and install

automations.name: Quote follow-up
automations.title: Follow up on the open quote
automations.why: Ten quiet days after a quote.

name: Manufacturer's rep
tagline: RFQs, vendor quotes, customer quotes, POs.
description: A manufacturer's representative: triage the RFQ, get pricing from the lines you represent, build the customer quote, chase the PO, then track acknowledgement, shipment, and invoicing. Tracks RFQ number, vendor, commission rate, and requested ship date.

stages.label: RFQ Received
stages.desc: Customer sent a request for quote

stages.label: Customer Quote Sent
stages.desc: Our quote is with the customer

stages.label: PO Received
stages.desc: Order placed with the vendor; tracking ack and ship

fields.name: rfq_number
fields.label: RFQ number
fields.why: How the customer refers to it.

automations.name: Quote follow-up
automations.title: Follow up on the customer quote
automations.why: Seven days without a customer response.

automations.name: POs are hot
automations.why: Real orders need watching through ship.

name: Field / technical services
description: Technical field services: a service request or quote ask, a site survey, a proposal for a fix or a service contract, approval, scheduling, completion. Tracks service type, site, contract value, one-off vs recurring, and the scheduled date.

stages.label: Request
stages.desc: Customer asked for service or a quote

stages.label: Approved — Scheduling
stages.desc: Customer said yes; booking the crew

fields.name: scheduled_date
fields.label: Scheduled date
fields.why: The day the crew is booked.

automations.name: Approved but not scheduled
automations.why: Approved work sitting unscheduled for five days is lost goodwill.

name: Nonprofit / fundraising
description: Raising money from individuals, foundations, and corporations: identify a prospect, cultivate the relationship, make the ask or submit the grant proposal, receive a pledge, then the gift. Tracks ask amount, gift type, program, and pledge date.

stages.label: Prospect
stages.desc: Identified; capacity and affinity look right

stages.label: Ask Made / Proposal Submitted
stages.desc: We asked, or the grant is in

automations.name: Proposal unanswered
automations.title: Follow up on the ask / proposal
automations.why: Thirty days without a word from a funder.

views.name: Pledged, not received
views.why: Money promised but not in the bank.
